values.subject: Jiaxing Zhizao: Final Visitor Instructions (Please Relay to All Personnel)
values.body_text: Same-day process: at 8:40, register at the gate and collect a visitor pass; at 9:00, attend a 20-minute safety briefing; afterward, enter the workshop in two groups. The stamping area has continuous, loud high-decibel noise, so everyone must wear earplugs; there is dust in the grinding area, so wear a mask and pass through quickly. The forklift lane is bounded by a yellow line, which must not be crossed under any circumstances. Photography is prohibited throughout the customer prototype area, but photos may be taken at the group-photo spot in the lobby. If you feel unwell during the visit, raise your hand to signal; the safety officer will take you to the rest area, and you do not need to explain why.
